title: [logits] Fuse LM-head all-gather permute-copy into next_token_logits_buffer
body:
## Problem

All-gather for vocab-parallel creates two `[num_tokens, vocab]` intermediate tensors:
```
output_tensor = torch.empty(
    output_size, dtype=input_.dtype, device=input_.device
)  # new [tp * num_tokens, vocab/tp]

output_tensor = output_tensor.reshape((world_size,) + input_size)
output_tensor = output_tensor.movedim(0, dim)  # non-contiguous
output_tensor = output_tensor.reshape(
    input_size[:dim] + (world_size * input_size[dim],) + input_size[dim + 1 :]
)  # new [num_tokens, tp, vocab/tp]
```

## Fix

Let NCCL write to a pre-allocated, shared buffer, then transpose-copy into the existing `next_token_logits_buffer`. Falls back to the generic all-gather when the buffer is absent or the layout doesn't match.
